summary: AgentPress exposes payment capability metadata so agents can reason about paid work, quotes, budgets, receipts, and x402 readiness. Public AgentPress files do not authorize any payment, wallet use, private key access, paid API call, or production money movement.

supported_payment_protocols.role: HTTP 402-compatible discovery and future paid API/content access

agent_answer: Yes, agents benefit from payment metadata and x402 readiness. No, the first-contact website should not demand or execute payment by default.
